items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: I took a few lessons with him to develop my boy.

ctx.x: Not this one. Not the German. No.

I like that from this old German professor that was teaching at Grimmauld, Fink. He died. The violin player was he? Professor Fink. Yeah, he was teaching bass over there. And I took a few lessons with him to develop my boy. I liked quite a bit but I mean I never did practice it because I didn't have no use for it. I mean the kind of music I play, I mean you don't ever have no call for no boy.
Were you in the service? Did you get the Gihan Bell for doing that?
